region_or_platform_notes: The models page lists Speech to Speech (grok-voice-2.0) as Deprecated at $0.08 / min ($4.80 / hr) $0.004 / text input. Those prices are not per million tokens. The models page does not print a shutdown date for this id. The release notes say grok-voice-2.0 is deprecated and to set model to grok-voice-3.0 or grok-voice-latest. They do not print a shutdown date.
